acceptance_criteria.description: The notes table gains a nullable text column 'body' through the next Alembic migration (expand-only, no data backfill)
Both upgrade and downgrade of the migration work
A unit or integration test asserts the new column persists

architectural_constraints: Follow the existing patterns and test style of the touched modules
No new dependencies without an explicit operator decision
Expand-only migration: no destructive operations; the chart runs migrations post-deploy, so the change must stay backward-compatible with the running deployment
